testCase.name: XML Layout Inflation
testCase.description: Runtime inflation error due to unknown attribute

error.message: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView

expectedFix.explanation: Remove invalid attribute or use android:textStyle="bold"

agent_response.error: Binary XML file line #12: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView
agent_response.rootCause: Error inflating class android.widget.TextView at line 12: activity_main.xml - Unknown attribute 'andr' used in XML file
fixGuidelines: Step 1: Verify that all TextView elements in activity_main.xml have valid attributes. Check for any unknown or unsupported attributes and remove them.
Step 2: Ensure that the TextView is created with appropriate dimensions and constraints. If using a ConstraintLayout, verify that the constraints are correctly defined to avoid layout issues.
Step 3: Test the changes by inflating the activity_main.xml file again in the emulator to confirm if the error persists or improves
Step 4: If the issue remains, inspect other XML files used by the app (like other .xml files) for similar unknown attributes and apply the same corrections as needed.
